section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing installation of straight pin through differential case and pinion shaft using a hammer and punch

items: Using a hammer and punch, drive the straight pin through the case and hole in the pinion shaft.
Stake the pin and differential case.

content.description: Diagram showing SST (special service tool) being used to press side bearing into differential case

content.text: Using SST and a press, drive a new side bearing into the differential case.
8. INSTALL RING GEAR ON DIFFERENTIAL CASE

items: (a) Clean the contact surface of the differential case.
(b) Heat the ring gear to about 100°C (212°F) in an oil bath.
(c) Clean the contact surface of the ring gear with cleaning solvent.
(d) Then quickly install the ring gear on the differential case.
(e) Align the marks on the ring gear and differential case.

content.text: Do not heat the ring gear more than 110°C (230°F).

items: (f) Coat the ring gear set bolts with gear oil.
(g) Install the lock plates and set bolts. Tighten the set bolts uniformly, a little at a time. Torque the bolts.

content.description: Illustration showing installation and torquing of ring gear bolts onto differential case
Detailed view showing how to stake lock plates using hammer and drift punch

content.text: (h) Using a hammer and drift punch, stake the lock plates.
Stake one claw flush with the flat surface of the nut. For the claw contacting the protruding portion of the nut, stake only the half on the right-hand side.
